requirements.text: CLAIM-CLASS PROHIBITION ('The separate ceilings do not describe one permitted building' / 'Until the third claim is established, I would prefer wording such as Preliminary development limits and Generated building option'): the product must NEVER present per-dimension regulatory ceilings (height, footprint, floor area) as one permitted building, and must NOT use unqualified 'maximum allowed building' / demonstrated-maximum wording until a demonstrated maximum (R009 evidence standard) is established. Interim vocabulary for max-envelope surfaces: 'Preliminary development limits' for the per-rule ceilings and 'Generated building option' for a computed massing that passes the implemented checks.
requirements.required_harness: Web specs on every max-derived surface assert the interim vocabulary and assert the absence of unqualified maximum-building claims; copy review in HJ walkthroughs.
requirements.required_evidence: UI increment specs + HJ report at each max-surfacing acceptance.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; binds the D-082-R003 UI surfacing increment at its contract seam.

requirements.text: THREE CLAIM CLASSES ('The program should clearly distinguish'): product copy, reports, and API vocabulary distinguish (a) a REGULATORY LIMIT - a ceiling established by a rule; (b) a GENERATED BUILDING OPTION - a particular shape that passes the implemented checks; (c) a DEMONSTRATED MAXIMUM - an optimum established within a STATED set of rules, assumptions, and supported building configurations. Class (c) is unavailable until its evidence standard (R009) is met.
requirements.required_harness: Typed claim-class vocabulary in the max-envelope response/UI contract; specs assert each surfaced number carries its class.
requirements.required_evidence: Contract + web specs at the max-surfacing increment's acceptance.

requirements.text: ANSWER-FIRST FLOW ('The architect should not have to enter a building outline simply to discover the site's basic limits'): the first experience after address confirm surfaces the supported development limits (floor area, height, yards, setbacks, coverage as computable), the assumptions, and the specific unresolved conditions - BEFORE any drawing or outline entry; testing a design and saving/sharing the analysis are subsequent chosen steps. Consistent with D-082-R003 (max leads, manual stays).
requirements.required_harness: HJ walkthrough proves the limits render without any designer input; e2e journey asserts the sequence.
requirements.required_evidence: Web increment + HJ report at the surfacing increment's acceptance.

requirements.text: NO UNRESTRICTED GREEN PASS ('where a necessary rule cannot be evaluated, the overall result must remain incomplete'): whenever any necessary rule for the lot is COULD_NOT_CHECK/unresolved, the OVERALL verdict presentation stays visibly incomplete - supported limits may render, but no unrestricted green pass/complete state is shown. Extends the existing per-rule honesty discipline to the aggregate verdict surface.
requirements.required_harness: Specs assert the aggregate state degrades to incomplete when any necessary rule is unevaluated; mutation test flips a gap and the green state must disappear.
requirements.required_evidence: Engine/UI specs at the relevant increments' acceptance.

requirements.text: DESIGN-TOOL ERGONOMICS DIRECTION ('provided it feels like a design tool'): the proposal editor grows toward exact-dimension entry, wall-distance-from-boundary adjustment, undo, and live measurements while editing; the coordinate table remains available but recedes to an advanced option; coordinate conversion happens automatically in the normal flow (the architect never needs to understand the city coordinate system). Direction for future editor increments - not a retrofit obligation on accepted slices.
requirements.required_harness: Future editor packets cite this row; each increment's AS pack covers the ergonomic behaviors it delivers.
requirements.required_evidence: Packet citations + increment specs as contracted.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; sequencing owned by replanning.

requirements.text: INPUT-PRECISION PROVENANCE ('a precise conversion does not make a roughly clicked point precise'): the system distinguishes and displays a preliminary sketch (clicked/roughly placed geometry) from geometry supported by a survey or confirmed measurements; conversion precision never upgrades input precision; the distinction carries into checks and reports.
requirements.required_harness: Typed input-precision class on drawn/clicked geometry; specs assert the sketch label persists through bridge conversion and adoption.
requirements.required_evidence: Contract + specs at the increment that introduces the class.

requirements.text: IMPORT ROUTE - PENDING OWNER DECISION ('I would eventually want a practical import route ... one supported CAD format or a scaled PDF that the architect aligns and traces'): captured as future direction ONLY. Phase C (assisted PDF import) and phase D remain NOT released (D-082-R001 boundary unchanged); contracting any import work requires a new owner release.
requirements.required_harness: No import-scope packet exists citing D-083 alone; any future import packet cites an explicit owner release.
requirements.required_evidence: Absence of import-scope packets on this authority; a future owner release record when decided.
requirements.status_reason: Owner decision pending; nothing contracted on this row.

requirements.text: ACTIONABLE CHECK FEEDBACK ('Checking my design must tell me what to change'): check results grow from pass/fail-with-citation toward identifying the affected wall/floor, stating the actual discrepancy (e.g. distance into a required yard), and highlighting the affected area; the editor grows to represent the design being checked - differing upper-floor footprints, setbacks, floor heights, and a retained existing building. Direction for future increments.
requirements.required_harness: Future check-surface packets cite this row; deterministic engine produces the discrepancy facts (no LLM in the math), AI may phrase explanations under existing boundaries.
requirements.required_evidence: Packet citations + increment specs as contracted.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; sequencing owned by replanning.

requirements.text: EVIDENCE STANDARD FOR MAXIMUM CLAIMS ('Feeding the generated building back into the checker ... does not prove everything'): the generator-checker consistency proof is necessary but NOT sufficient - it does not establish rule completeness/correct interpretation, and does not prove a larger compliant design impossible. Before any demonstrated-maximum claim (R002 class c): independently prepared examples, checked against official sources and reviewed by a qualified professional (architect/qualified reviewer), test the claims. Until then, class (a)/(b) vocabulary only.
requirements.required_harness: A demonstrated-maximum claim ships only with an independently-prepared golden-example pack verified against official sources and a qualified-reviewer approval record (permanent principle 1/12 alignment).
requirements.required_evidence: Golden-example pack + qualified-reviewer record at whatever increment first makes the class-c claim.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; no class-c claim exists in the product today.

requirements.text: SITE-BOUNDARY PROVENANCE LABELS ('grouping parcels in your software does not itself establish their legal treatment as one zoning lot'): the interface identifies whether a site boundary is (a) an official mapped record, (b) a professional's documented assertion, or (c) a proposed scenario; software grouping never claims legal zoning-lot establishment (ZR 12-10 zoning-lot conditions govern); when a site-definition record changes, existing analyses retain their original basis and clearly indicate when a new calculation is needed.
requirements.required_harness: Site-definition surfaces carry the three-way provenance label; analyses pin their site-basis identity; specs assert the stale-basis indicator on record change.
requirements.required_evidence: Web/API specs at the site-definition surfacing increments' acceptance (extends the accepted T059/T063 honesty pattern).

requirements.text: RETURN ITEM ('explain why the coordinate converter and preliminary calculator depend on the same sign-in milestone'): report to the owner, in plain English, whether the converter and the max calculator have legitimate shared dependencies on the sign-in/protection milestone or are separable for an earlier working trial sequence; recommend the release grouping.
requirements.required_harness: Owner-facing reply delivered; the reasoning recorded in this directive's audit_log or a report file.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; answer owed this session.

requirements.text: REQUESTED DEMONSTRATION ('The next demonstration I would request'): one ordinary property taken all the way through the answer-first experience, then a condo, then a project the operating architect already knows; operated without coaching, observing hesitation points, questioned results, and whether a client-sendable output is produced. Captured as the acceptance bar for the next owner-facing demo seam.
requirements.required_harness: The next demo/walkthrough seam uses this three-property uncoached protocol; HJ walkthrough mirrors it in the interim.
requirements.required_evidence: Demo record / HJ journey reports at that seam.

requirements.text: COMPLETE USABLE PATH AT THE ARCHITECT TRIAL ('A disabled Convert button is acceptable in an internal preview. For an architect's trial, I would present a working sequence with the necessary protection in place'): sequencing - before any architect-facing trial, the presented sequence works end-to-end with the necessary protection enabled; disabled-feature placeholders are acceptable only in internal previews.
requirements.required_harness: The trial-release plan sequences protection + enablement before the architect trial; no trial seam ships a dead primary action.
requirements.required_evidence: Release/trial planning records at that seam.
